Annalen des Naturhistorischen Museums in Wien: 263–282. Available from: http://www.jstor.org/stable/41768681. the probability of the specimen being P. strouhali is very high, however he did not get to see the animals himself. Can also be found in Brehm V (1942) Nochmals die Biocoenosen der Lunzer Gewässer. Internat. Revue ges. Hydrobiol. 42: 289–316. AND IN Strouhal H, Vornatscher J (1975) Katalog der rezenten Höhlentiere Österreichs. Annalen des Naturhistorischen Museums in Wien 79: 401–542. AND IN Danielopol DL (1976) Sur la distribution géographique de la faune interstitielle du Danube et de certains de ses affluents en Basse-Autriche. International Journal of Speleology 8: 323–329. https://doi.org/10.5038/1827-806x.8.4.2., where states that the distribution of P. strouhali in this area (lower Austria) is much more limited that that of P. slavus. Can also be found in: Wolf B (1934) 1–3 Animalium Cavernarum Catalogua. Berlin. AND IN  Breuss W (1995) Zum Vorkommen von Arthropoden in einigen Höhlen Vorarlbergs (Österreich). Berichte des naturwissenschaftlichen-medizinischen Verein Innsbruck 82: 227–240.
